statement: Let s be the non-decreasing rearrangement of nums, i.e. the unique sequence of length n such that s[0] <= s[1] <= ... <= s[n-1] and s has the same multiset of values as nums. Say indices i and j (0 <= i, j < n) are gcd-connected if there is m >= 0 and a sequence of indices a_0, ..., a_m with a_0 = i, a_m = j and gcd(nums[a_t], nums[a_{t+1}]) > 1 for every 0 <= t < m. The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < n, the multiset of values nums[j] over all j with 0 <= j < n that are gcd-connected to i equals the multiset of values s[j] over those same j.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, and for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000. (The problem lists 2 <= nums[k]; we allow 1 because the provided examples contain 1, and gcd(1, x) = 1 for every x.)

statement: The function returns a result r (it never returns an error, panics, goes out of bounds, or overflows).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, and for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = true.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). n = 1, and 1 <= nums[0] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if (nums[0] <= nums[1] or gcd(nums[0], nums[1]) > 1).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). n = 2, and 1 <= nums[0], nums[1] <= 100000.

statement: Say i and j (0 <= i, j < n) are gcd-connected if there is m >= 0 and indices a_0, ..., a_m with a_0 = i, a_m = j and gcd(nums[a_t], nums[a_{t+1}]) > 1 for every 0 <= t < m. If for every pair i, j with 0 <= i, j < n, i and j are gcd-connected (there is a single component), then the function returns a result r and r = true.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, and for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000.

statement: Let s be the non-decreasing rearrangement of nums. Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true, then for every i with 0 <= i < n: if gcd(nums[i], nums[j]) = 1 for every j with 0 <= j < n and j != i, then nums[i] = s[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, and for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000.

statement: Let s be the non-decreasing rearrangement of nums. Say i and j (0 <= i, j < n) are gcd-connected if there is m >= 0 and indices a_0, ..., a_m with a_0 = i, a_m = j and gcd(nums[a_t], nums[a_{t+1}]) > 1 for every 0 <= t < m. Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true, then for every i with 0 <= i < n there exists j with 0 <= j < n such that j is gcd-connected to i and nums[j] = s[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, and for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000.

statement: Let s be the non-decreasing rearrangement of nums. Say values u and v (each appearing among nums[0], ..., nums[n-1]) are in the same value-component if u = v or there exist m >= 1 and values w_0, ..., w_m, each appearing among nums[0], ..., nums[n-1], with w_0 = u, w_m = v and gcd(w_t, w_{t+1}) > 1 for every 0 <= t < m. Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true, then for every i with 0 <= i < n, nums[i] and s[i] are in the same value-component.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, and for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000.

statement: Let s be the non-decreasing rearrangement of nums. The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if nums is non-decreasing (nums[k] <= nums[k+1] for every 0 <= k < n - 1).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000, and for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < n, gcd(nums[i], nums[j]) = 1.

statement: Let s be the non-decreasing rearrangement of nums. If the function returns a result r and there exists i with 0 <= i < n such that gcd(nums[i], nums[j]) = 1 for every j with 0 <= j < n and j != i and nums[i] != s[i], then r = false.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, and for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000.

statement: Let s be the non-decreasing rearrangement of nums. Say i and j (0 <= i, j < n) are gcd-connected if there is m >= 0 and indices a_0, ..., a_m with a_0 = i, a_m = j and gcd(nums[a_t], nums[a_{t+1}]) > 1 for every 0 <= t < m. Whenever the function returns a result r with r = false, there exist an index i with 0 <= i < n and an integer value v such that the number of j with 0 <= j < n that are gcd-connected to i and satisfy nums[j] = v differs from the number of j with 0 <= j < n that are gcd-connected to i and satisfy s[j] = v.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, and for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000.

statement: Let s be the non-decreasing rearrangement of nums. Say values u and v (each appearing among nums[0], ..., nums[n-1]) are in the same value-component if u = v or there exist m >= 1 and values w_0, ..., w_m, each appearing among nums[0], ..., nums[n-1], with w_0 = u, w_m = v and gcd(w_t, w_{t+1}) > 1 for every 0 <= t < m. If for every i with 0 <= i < n, nums[i] and s[i] are in the same value-component, then the function returns a result r and r = true.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 30000, and for every k with 0 <= k < n, 1 <= nums[k] <= 100000.
